info.title: Player2 Developer API
info.description: The **Player2 API** gives AI tools to developers for building their own AI powered games/mods or players for powering AI games that supports local AI models. ## Prerequisites * Download and run the latest version of the Player2 App at https://player2.game. ## Calling the API The Player2 API is hosted at `http://127.0.0.1:4315` while the App is running. You can point your game or application to this URL to start making requests. Because `http://localhost:4315` doesn't work due to IP6 conflicts, try to use `http://127.0.0.1:4315` directly. You can also access the API via the Swagger UI at `http://localhost:4315/docs` where you can interact with the API directly. ## Creating a game [For Game Developers Only] Before you start using the API create your game in the [Developer Dashboard](https://player2.game/profile/developer). And make note of the Game Client Id - no need to publish the game yet. ## Authentication [For Game Developers Only] Users must be authenticated in the Player2 App for the API to work. Put your Game Client Id in a `player2-game-key` header of all your requests. Your Game Client Id can be found in the [Developer Dashboard](https://player2.game/profile/developer) under your game. We also highly recommend `pinging the health end point every 60s`, this allows us to calculate your game's `time-spent` and time-spent is used to calculate your game's revenue share in our reward program partly. ## Getting Help If you have any questions or need help, please join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/s53vEvV2Fr). ## Web API If your game does not allow access to localhost (127.0.0.1) or it is a multiplayer game, you can use our [Web API](https://player2.game/docs/api-reference) instead. ## Alternative API format The **Alternative API format** section provides compatibility endpoints for applications that use **Whisper STT** (OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text) or **ElevenLabs TTS** (text-to-speech) API formats. These endpoints use the **same underlying models** selected by the user in the Player2 App - they simply provide a familiar API format for easier integration with existing applications. post.description:
Enqueues an async sprite animation job that converts an existing image asset into
an animated spritesheet and GIF. Returns a `job_id` immediately — poll
`GET /v1/sprite/job/{job_id}` until `status` is `"completed"`.

Costs 100 joules per job.

VideoGenerateFromImageRequest.description:
Image-to-video generation request

# Examples
- **Animate image**: `{"prompt": "The cat slowly blinks and flicks its tail", "image": "<base64>", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"}`

aspect_ratio.description: Video aspect ratio: "16:9", "9:16", "1:1", "4:3", "3:4". Defaults to "1:1" if not specified.

image.description: Base64 encoded source image (without data URI prefix)

prompt.description: Text prompt describing how to animate the image. Maximum 1024 tokens.

example.prompt: The cat slowly blinks and flicks its tail
